description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'EmployeeEventSearchFilterParams' used for filtering employee event searches within an HRM system. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class, including properties for employee number, date range, event type, and event description, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeEventSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class extending FilterParams to encapsulate filter criteria for employee event search, including employee number, date range, type, and event.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getDateRange
methods.description: Returns the date range filter criterion, or null if not set.

methods.name: setDateRange
methods.description: Sets the date range filter criterion.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of event filter criterion, or null if not set.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the event type filter criterion.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Returns the specific event filter criterion, or null if not set.
